---
project: slowburn
one_line: Slow tracks, add reverb, and save an A-B loop per song on Windows.
stack: [TypeScript]
status: draft
since: 2026-10
capabilities: []
limits: []
updated: 2026-11-22
draft: true
---

Slowburn plays your local library at reduced speed with reverb, tempo and pitch control. Each track keeps its own A-B loop, so a section you mark is still there when you reopen the song. It is a Tauri desktop app with a React front end.
